description: Run the extension while you edit it (dev build, hot reload, browser): the first call for "run my extension". ready.status "ready" means nothing else to call. extension_start runs the production build.

allowControl.description: Control channel for the bridge verbs.

browser.description: Target browser; *-based pairs with chromiumBinary or geckoBinary.

chromiumBinary.description: Chromium binary; browser still names the target family.

developmentTeam.description: Safari: Apple team id; omitted, ad-hoc.

enableExtension.description: Safari: enable it in Settings (Accessibility grant).

geckoBinary.description: Gecko binary; browser still names the target family.

headless.description: true: headless; false: a visible window; omitted: env decides.

macOsOnly.description: Safari: false adds iOS and iPadOS.

profile.description: Profile path; "false" reuses the real one.

publicHost.description: Host the browser dials, if not host.

replace.description: Replace this project's session; else refused.

wait.description: Wait up to 45 s for ready.

name: extension_dev
